claims.text: The resort cascades down a hillside towards the Indian Ocean.

findings.quote: Cascading down the hillside towards the Indian Ocean, Raffles Bali is the ultimate in refined barefoot luxury.

claims.text: Each villa has its own pool and garden, with views across Jimbaran Bay.

findings.quote: Our 32 villas, each with its own pool and garden, offer peace and privacy to soothe the soul, with views across Jimbaran Bay that seem to go on forever.

claims.text: The private limousine transfer from Ngurah Rai International Airport takes less than half an hour.

findings.quote: The private limousine transfer from Ngurah Rai International Airport to Raffles Bali is less than half an hour

claims.text: The restaurant Rumari is set at the highest point of the resort.

findings.quote: Rumari is set between sun and sea at the highest point of our beautiful resort.

claims.text: At Rumari, chef Gaetan Biesuz presents progressive Indonesian cuisine.

findings.quote: Here culinary maestro Gaetan Biesuz creates authentic bold flavours, presenting progressive Indonesian cuisine in an organic, contemporary way.

claims.text: The Writers Bar serves classic and spiced cocktails on a terrace with ocean and sunset views.

findings.quote: ### The Writers Bar
Classics and whimsically spiced cocktails on a terrace offering shimmering ocean and sunset views.

claims.text: The resort has a private beach.

findings.quote: we invite you to enjoy our private beach, infinity pool, fitness centre and tennis.

claims.text: The Sanctuary is a remote hillside treatment suite for signature treatments and wellness journeys.

findings.quote: book a signature treatment or wellness journey at our remote hillside treatment suite. The Sanctuary spirits you away to a jungle idyll

claims.text: Spa treatments may be carried out in the privacy of the guest's villa.

findings.quote: Spa treatments may be carried out in the privacy of your villa.

claims.text: The resort has two clay-surface tennis and pickleball courts.

findings.quote: 2 clay-surface tennis and pickleball courts

claims.text: The Raffles Butler arranges a selection of cultural experiences and leisure activities.

findings.quote: Your Raffles Butler will arrange a selection of cultural experiences and leisure activities, thoughtfully curated to enrich your stay.

claims.text: The Secret Cave offers dining in a dramatic cave, with flickering torches leading to the table.

findings.quote: ### The Secret Cave
Dine in the magical, ancient setting of this dramatic cave. Flickering torches lead to your table for this one-of-a-kind dining experience.

claims.text: The Rumari Counter is a chef's table for up to ten guests where no menu is ever the same.

findings.quote: Counter offers an intimate dining experience for up to ten guests, where no menu is ever the same.
The Rumari Counter is an intimate chef's table experience in Bali, limited to ten guests per evening.

claims.text: The Soul Blessing Ceremony is a guided ritual led by a Balinese priest at the resort temple.

findings.quote: The Soul Blessing Ceremony at Raffles Bali is a guided ritual led by a Balinese priest at the resort temple.

claims.text: The seaside infinity pool looks out to Mount Agung on clear days.

findings.quote: Perched seaside with sweeping ocean views, our 25-metre infinity pool reveals Bali’s majestic Mount Agung on clear days.

claims.text: Rumari follows an 80/20 philosophy: 80% of produce is sourced from the Indonesian archipelago and 20% is imported out of necessity.

findings.quote: His 80/20 philosophy means that 80% of produce is sourced from the archipelago, while 20% is imported out of necessity.
guided by its 80/20 philosophy, where most ingredients are sourced from across the Indonesian archipelago

claims.text: The resort's hillside in Jimbaran is seeing nearby development, which may occasionally cause daytime noise.

findings.quote: our tranquil hillside in Jimbaran is seeing nearby development. While this reflects the island’s evolving energy, it may occasionally result in daytime noise.

claims.text: At Rumari, slip-ons and flip-flops are not permitted.
